motion.name: animation-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, pressed, selected, and focus color changes.

motion.name: popup-dismiss
motion.purpose: Closes a popup after the pointer leaves both popup and anchor.

components.name: Bar
components.description: Persistent 38px status bar with left, centered, and right module groups.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 6px; background: rgba(29, 32, 33, 0.96); color: #d4be98; font: 600 16px/1 "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"; border-bottom: 1px solid #3c3836; } .ds-bar-center { margin: 0 auto; background: #282828; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Compact launcher-style action with a green base and dark glyph or label.
components.css: .ds-accent-button { height: 30px; padding: 0 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #a9b665; color: #1d2021; font: 600 14px/1 "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-accent-button:hover { background: #89b482; } .ds-accent-button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #89b482; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-accent-button:active { background: #d8a657; }

components.name: Popup Surface
components.description: Large contextual surface anchored below a bar module.
components.css: .ds-popup-surface { width: 410px; padding: 14px; background: #282828; color: #ddc7a1; border: 1px solid #3c3836; border-radius: 4px; font-family: "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"; } .ds-popup-surface h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-popup-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 2px; color: #d4be98; font-size: 14px; } .ds-popup-row:hover { background: #32302f; } .ds-popup-row span { color: #a89984; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Password field used when a protected network needs credentials.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #3c3836; border-radius: 4px; background: #1d2021; color: #ddc7a1; font: 14px "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #89b482; outline: none; }

components.name: Slider
components.description: Restrained 4px track with semantic fill and a small handle.
components.css: .ds-slider { position: relative; height: 22px; padding-top: 9px; } .ds-slider::before, .ds-slider span { display: block; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; content: ""; } .ds-slider::before { background: #504945; } .ds-slider span { width: 60%; margin-top: -4px; background: #a9b665; } .ds-slider i { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: calc(60% - 5px); width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: #ddc7a1; }

narrative.overview:
This is a compact, flat desktop shell built in Gruvbox Material Dark Hard. The 38px top bar keeps workspace, window, media, and system state readable at a glance; larger contextual popups provide depth only when opened. The supplied captures show the bar sitting quietly over active applications rather than competing with them.

JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, one-pixel separators, tonal dark surfaces, straight corners, and semantic status colors make the system feel utilitarian and restrained. Interactions are short, local color changes and separate popup windows, not blocking overlays.
keyCharacteristics: Gruvbox Material dark neutrals with restrained semantic accents.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Accents identify state or action; they do not decorate whole surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep the bar and controls flat at rest; use tonal state changes instead of shadows or gradients.

dos: Do preserve the 38px bar and 30px module rhythm.
Do keep popup surfaces larger than bar modules, padded by 14px, and anchored to the triggering module.
Do use green, aqua, yellow, orange, and red only for their observed state or action meanings.
Do keep interactions nonblocking: local hover/press feedback, Escape dismissal, and separate contextual popups.
donts: Don't introduce pill shapes, large rounded cards, gradients, or drop shadows into the shell.
Don't turn the persistent bar into a dashboard or full-screen control surface.
Don't use saturated accents as general backgrounds; reserve them for state and action.
